## Trump remains underwater in national polling averages

Trump’s new low in the Economist/YouGov poll comes as several national polling averages show substantially more Americans disapproving than approving of his job performance.

As of Thursday, Nov. 12, the RealClearPolitics average put Trump at 38.7% approval and 59.1% disapproval. [...] A majority also said Trump is using the presidency for personal gain, while 50% said they support Congress blocking his White House ballroom.

The Economist/YouGov poll was conducted Nov. 9-11 among 1,685 U.S. citizens and has a margin of error of 3 percentage point
